headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.
The reading fell short of a projection of 3.98 per cent from economists polled by financial data provider Wind. On a...

国家统计局发布的数据显示，7月工业生产者出厂价格指数（PPI）同比上涨3.5%，低于6月的4.1%

headlines.title: What makes McDonald’s assets stand out amid a weak Hong Kong retail property market?
headlines.summary:
One year after McDonald’s began selling its self-owned Hong Kong shops, the fast-food giant has found buyers for nearly half its portfolio even as the city’s retail property market endures its weakest spell in decades.
McDonald’s planned to dispose of all 23 shops in phases, market sources said, with the portfolio initially valued at about HK$3 billion (US$382 million).

headlines.title: 高塔姆·阿达尼赢得美国证券欺诈指控的驳回
headlines.summary: 美国纽约东区联邦地区法院法官Nicholas Garaufis驳回了对高塔姆·阿达尼及其侄子萨加尔·阿达尼的共谋、证券欺诈和电信欺诈指控。 美国方面指控阿达尼参与了一项向印度政府官员行贿超过2.5亿美元以锁定太阳能合同的计划——阿达尼始终否认这些指控。 该裁决标志着阿达尼在美国法律麻烦的终结，此前他还曾与美国证券交易委员会（SEC）和财政部达成和解。

headlines.title_en: Gautam Adani wins dismissal of US securities fraud charges
headlines.summary_en: US federal judge Nicholas Garaufis of the Eastern District of New York dismissed conspiracy, securities fraud and wire fraud charges against Gautam Adani and his nephew Sagar Adani. US authorities had accused Adani of participating in a scheme to bribe Indian government officials over $250 million to secure solar contracts - charges Adani consistently denied. The ruling ends Adani's US legal troubles, following prior settlements with the SEC and Treasury Department.

headlines.title_en: US 10-year Treasury yield rises more than 5 basis points
headlines.summary_en: Monday (August 10, the day after the US nonfarm payrolls report) New York late trading: US 10-year Treasury yield rose 5.51 basis points, matching the intraday high of 4.7005% set at 00:46 Beijing time, showing an extended V-shaped reversal after dipping to a daily low of 4.6393% at 15:15. Two-year Treasury yield rose 4.58 basis points, matching the intraday high of 4.2410% set at 00:44, extending gains since 16:00; 30-year Treasury yield rose 4.48 basis points to 5.2456%. The 2s10s yield spread widened 1.145 basis points to +45.953 basis points. The 10-year TIPS yield rose 3.65 basis points to 2.4256%; two-year TIPS yield fell 0.66 basis points.

headlines.title: 《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》印发 到2030年现代煤炭产业体系基本建成
headlines.summary: 【《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》印发 到2030年现代煤炭产业体系基本建成】国家发展改革委、国家能源局近日联合印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》（下称“规划”），明确到2030年煤炭兜底保障能力进一步增强，全国大型现代化煤矿产能比重提升至87%，智能化煤矿产能比例提升至75%，煤炭消费实现达峰，现代煤炭产业体系基本建成。这是我国在煤炭消费迎来达峰的关键窗口期，对行业高质量发展作出的系统性部署。

headlines.title_en: Coal Industry Development 15th Five-Year Plan issued—modern coal industry system basically established by 2030
headlines.summary_en: The '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development' has been issued, targeting a basically complete modern coal industry system by 2030. The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration jointly released the plan, which sets targets for enhanced coal supply security capacity by 2030, with the share of large modern coal mine capacity rising to 87%, intelligent coal mine capacity rising to 75%, coal consumption peaking, and a modern coal industry system basically established. This represents a systematic deployment for high-quality industry development during the critical window when China's coal consumption is set to peak.
